title: Special Topics in Bioengineering; Spatial Biology: Bioinformatics, Omics, and Technology
description:
Restrictions: Permission of the Fischell Department of Bioengineering

Introduction to modern spatial biology methods, beginning with clinical motivations and pathology, moving to the materials, imaging, and chemistries that enable spatial methods, and ending with spatial omics analysis and bioinformatics. This course will cover clinical and engineering background and theory, and practical spatial omics programming and analysis.
